description: Individually cited, precisely-located mineral/hydrothermal discoveries within the AquaNexus ARGO coverage region (60-100E, 0-30N). Each site is sourced from a specific peer-reviewed publication, not an approximated zone.

sites.name: Wocan Hydrothermal Field
sites.citation: Han et al., mineralogy/trace element study, Wocan Hydrothermal Field (WHF, 6°22'N/60°31'E), Carlsberg Ridge, Indian Ocean. ScienceDirect.
sites.notes: Sulfide mound ~260m diameter, ~50m height. Southern area Cu-rich sulfides, northern area Fe-rich sulfides.

sites.name: Tianshi Hydrothermal Field
sites.citation: Qiu, Z., Wang, Y., Han, X. et al. (2024). Discovery and characterization of a new hydrothermal field at 2N on the slow-spreading Carlsberg Ridge. Journal of Oceanology and Limnology, 42, 1106-1118. DOI: 10.1007/s00343-023-3076-7
sites.notes: Located on rift valley wall between 2 deg 35'N and 2 deg 43'N. Hydrothermal Fe flux 30-155 mg/(cm2*ka), Cu flux 0.59-11.49 mg/(cm2*ka).

sites.name: Carlsberg Ridge 3.7N Hydrothermal Plume Site
sites.discovery_method: Plume detection (Ray et al. 2012), sulfide sampling (Tao et al. 2013)
sites.citation: Ray, D. et al. (2013a), hydrothermal plumes identified near 3°42'N, 63°40'E on Carlsberg Ridge via optical backscatter, thermal anomalies, and chemical signatures (dE, 3He, Mn).
sites.notes: Hydrothermal plume discovered near 3 deg 42'N; polymetallic sulfides physically sampled in 2012.

sites.name: Andaman Seamount SM-13 (Nicobar volcanic arc)
sites.discovery_method: RV Sindhu Sadhana survey of 13 seamounts (SM1-SM13), Nov 2021
sites.citation: Peketi, A., Sriram, G., Mazumdar, A. et al. (2024). Hydrothermal amorphous silica, barite and orpiment from the crater area of seamount (SM-13) off Nicobar island, Andaman sea. Marine and Petroleum Geology, 160, 106606. DOI: 10.1016/j.marpetgeo.2023.106606
sites.notes: Only 1 of 13 surveyed seamounts (SM-13) showed confirmed hydrothermal evidence: amorphous silica, barite, orpiment, chemosymbiotic Bathymodiolus organisms, CO2-rich plumes.

sites.name: Durgarajupatnam Coast Heavy Mineral Placer
sites.discovery_method: Geological Survey of India (GSI) coastal survey
sites.citation: Delineation of the general framework and quantification of heavy minerals distribution at Durgarajupatnam coast, Nellore, East Coast of India. ScienceDirect, 2024. Coordinates 14 deg 0'10"-14 deg 02'30"N, 80 deg 08'20"-80 deg 19'00"E, GSI toposheets 66B3,4 and 66C1,5.
sites.notes: Bay of Bengal coastal placer, Nellore district Andhra Pradesh. Opaque mineral content averaged 10.63% in June 2016 survey.

sites.name: Chhatrapur Beach Placer Deposit
sites.discovery_method: Atomic Minerals Division / GSI beach placer exploration
sites.citation: Geochemical studies of monazite sands of Chhatrapur beach placer deposit of Orissa, India by PIXE and EDXRF method. ScienceDirect. One of India's well-known REE-bearing placer deposits, Ganjam District, Orissa.
sites.notes: Bay of Bengal coastal placer. Monazite sands carry significant thorium/uranium/REE content; part of India's officially estimated beach sand mineral (BSM) resource inventory.

sites.name: Chavara Beach Placer Deposit
sites.discovery_method: Atomic Minerals Division / Indian Rare Earths Ltd exploration
sites.citation: Widely documented in Indian placer mineral literature (e.g. Beach Placer Deposits of India, their Distribution, Mineralogy and Sustainable-Mining, academia.edu). One of India's largest and oldest-worked ilmenite-monazite beach placers.
sites.notes: Arabian Sea coast, Kollam district, Kerala. Indian ilmenite here typically 50-60% TiO2.
